name: status_chart
description: A boolean indicator that visually represents true/false states using colored circles (traffic light style) or custom uploaded images. Use it to monitor whether a fan is running, a service is online, or any other binary status.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The boolean metric to monitor for true/false state

config.name: color_true
config.label: Color (yes)
config.description: The circle color displayed when the metric value is true

config.name: color_false
config.label: Color (no)
config.description: The circle color displayed when the metric value is false

config.name: image_true
config.label: Image (yes)
config.description: An image to display when the metric value is true. Takes priority over the color when set

config.name: image_false
config.label: Image (no)
config.description: An image to display when the metric value is false. Takes priority over the color when set

config.name: image_size
config.label: Size
config.description: How the image fills the widget. Cover scales to fill the entire area (may crop), Contain scales to fit within the area (may leave gaps)

config.name: image_position_x
config.label: Horizontal Align
config.description: The horizontal alignment of the image within the widget

config.name: image_position_y
config.label: Vertical Align
config.description: The vertical alignment of the image within the widget
